newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac revises redemption date for debenture.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac revises redemption date for debenture.

text.p: The Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp on Friday revised the redemption date to December 20 for the entire $150 million principal amount of its 6.78 percent fixed-rate debenture issue due March 28, 2001 with cusip 313400F32.
Freddie Mac previously had set a redemption date of December 5.

Freddie Mac also said it will pay principal plus accrued interest to the redemption date to holders of record as of the close of business on December 19. It previously set payment to holders of record as of December 4.
Freddie Mac said it will redeem the issue in its entirety at a price equal to 100 percent of principal.
